entries.task_id: the buddha|was|staying near mithilā in the maghadeva mango grove
entries.description: the Buddha was staying near Mithilā in the Maghadeva Mango Grove
entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying near Mithilā in the Maghadeva Mango Grove

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Mithilā in the Maghadeva Mango Grove.
Rañño kho panānanda, maghadevassa puttapaputtakā tassa paramparā caturāsītirājasahassāni imasmiṁyeva maghadevaambavane kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajiṁsu.

entries.description: Nimi was the last of those kings
entries.subject: Nimi

spans.text: Nimi tesaṁ rājā pacchimako ahosi dhammiko dhammarājā dhamme ṭhito mahārājā; Nimi was the last of those kings, a just and principled king, a great king who stood by his duty.

entries.task_id: sakka|vanished|from the thirty-three gods and reappeared in front of king nimi
entries.description: Sakka vanished from the thirty-three gods and reappeared in front of King Nimi
entries.subject: Sakka
entries.object: from the thirty-three gods and reappeared in front of King Nimi

spans.text: Then, as easily as a strong person would extend or contract their arm, Sakka vanished from the thirty-three gods and reappeared in front of King Nimi.
Then, knowing that the king had consented, as easily as a strong person would extend or contract their arm, Sakka vanished from King Nimi and reappeared among the gods of the thirty-three.
‘lābhā vata, bho, videhānaṁ, suladdhaṁ vata, bho, videhānaṁ, ‘The people of Videha are so fortunate, so very fortunate abhiruheyyāsi, mahārāja, dibbaṁ yānaṁ avikampamāno’ti.
King Nimi consented with silence.
Then, knowing that the king had consented, as easily as a strong person would extend or contract their arm, Sakka vanished from King Nimi and reappeared among the gods of the thirty-three.
Tena kho pana, ānanda, samayena nimi rājā tadahuposathe pannarase sīsaṁnhāto uposathiko uparipāsādavaragato nisinno hoti.

entries.description: time it was the fifteenth day sabbath
entries.subject: time it

spans.text: Now at that time it was the fifteenth day sabbath, and King Nimi had bathed his head and was sitting upstairs in the royal longhouse to observe the sabbath.
